title: The Winter of Harrow Glen
author: Kestrel Okafor
blurb: Coral Ishikawa, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
